hero.caption:
Location of the caves with the gypsum crystals within the idealized block diagram of Naica mine.
Indications in the image:

Swords cave:
Level: -120m
Aprox. crystals growth temperature: 45°C

Crystals cave:
Level: -290m
Aprox. crystals growth temperature: 55°C

Infographic by Albert Vila and Andreu Módenes with scientific monitoring Àngels Sabaté Canals, geologist at University of Barcelona (UB)
